title: Getting your project onto PythonAnywhere
author: Peter
content:
Getting your code onto PythonAnywhere involves the following steps:

Commit code to GIT locally.

Push code to GitHub

Hit the ‘Publish branch’ button

Pull code into PythonAnywhere
